theorems.name: Submission.dr_cc_lip_at_union
theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [PseudoMetricSpace X] [PseudoMetricSpace Y] (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (G : ι → Set X) (B : Set X) (g : X → Y) (y : X) (K : ℝ), (∀ k, IsClosed (G k)) → B ⊆ ⋃ k, G k → (∀ k, y ∈ G k → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y' ∈ G k ∩ B, dist y' y < δ → dist (g y') (g y) ≤ (K + ε) * dist y' y) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y' ∈ B, dist y' y < δ → dist (g y') (g y) ≤ (K + ε) * dist y' y
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
